description: Cancel a trigger armed with arm_price_trigger, before it fires (free). Requires both id and secret — the same token returned once at arm time and used to verify the webhook's HMAC signature — as proof of ownership. The $0.02 arm fee is not refunded; it paid for the monitoring already done. Returns 404 for an unknown id/secret pair, 409 if the trigger already fired or was already cancelled.
name: disarm_price_trigger
